# Contributing

Thank you for your interest in Microsoft365DSC. The full contributor documentation lives at
[microsoft365dsc.com](https://microsoft365dsc.com/contributing/contribution-guidelines/).

- [Contribution guidelines](https://microsoft365dsc.com/contributing/contribution-guidelines/) covers the branch policy, coding conventions and the review process.
- [Getting started](https://microsoft365dsc.com/contributing/getting-started/) covers setting up a development environment and building the module.
- [Develop a new resource](https://microsoft365dsc.com/contributing/develop-new-resource/) covers adding a resource with the resource generator.

The source of those pages is under `docs/docs/contributing/` in this repository.

AI coding agents should read [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) for the enforceable rules, plus the
path-scoped files under [.github/instructions/](./instructions/).
